TRRRack

Futuristic VR racing: starfighters, boost pads, loops and seven rivals who fight back.

Meta Quest ↗Meta Horizon StoreiPhoneComing soon

STEERING THAT MAKES YOU GRIN. Your starfighter goes exactly where you point it. Thread the gap, kiss the apex, carve a corner on the air brakes or sideshift a lane.

120 HZ. EVERYTHING ANSWERS. On Quest 3 every flick of the stick and every hit comes back the moment it happens.

SPEED YOU FEEL. Boost pads kick you forward, the road drops into jumps and climbs into loops under burning sunsets and starlit skies.

SIMPLE AT FIRST SIGHT. DEEP IN EVERY LAP. One energy bar is your turbo and your hull. Burn it or save it. Fire now or wait for the straight. Mines or shield.

A FIELD THAT FIGHTS BACK. Seven rivals, missiles, lightning and mines on every circuit. Blast their mines off the road. A commentator calls every lap, pass and hit.

YOUR GARAGE, YOUR ROOM. Five starfighters, 37 liveries. Switch on mixed reality and the track runs through your room.

YOU AGAINST YOU. Race the ghost of your best lap and climb the leaderboards with friends.
